challenges.title: Base64 Basics
challenges.desc:
Decode this Base64 string and enter the hidden word:

    SGVsbG9IYWNrZXI=
challenges.hint: Use Python: import base64; base64.b64decode('SGVsbG9IYWNrZXI=').decode()

challenges.title: Hex Decoder
challenges.desc:
Decode this hex string (remove underscore first):

    6374667b6865785f6973_66756e7d
challenges.hint: Python: bytes.fromhex('yourhex').decode()

challenges.title: Caesar Cipher
challenges.desc:
Decrypt this ROT13 encoded text:

    UNPXRE
challenges.hint: ROT13 shifts each letter by 13 positions.

challenges.title: Port Knowledge
challenges.desc:
What is the default port number for HTTPS traffic?

  Enter only the number.
challenges.hint: HTTP is 80, HTTPS is HTTP but encrypted...

challenges.title: Subnet Math
challenges.desc:
Network: 192.168.1.0/24

  How many USABLE host IPs does it have?
  (Enter only the number)
challenges.hint: Total = 2^(32-24). Subtract 2 for network + broadcast.

challenges.title: OSI Layer
challenges.desc:
The Transport layer is which OSI layer number?

  (Enter only the number)
challenges.hint: Mnemonic: Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away

challenges.title: SQL Injection
challenges.desc:
Which payload bypasses a SQL login form?

  a) ' OR '1'='1
  b) <script>alert(1)</script>
  c) ; DROP TABLE users;
  d) ../../../etc/passwd

  Enter the letter only.
challenges.hint: This manipulates the WHERE clause to always be true.

challenges.title: XSS Type
challenges.desc:
Which XSS type is stored in the database and hits every visitor?

  a) Reflected XSS
  b) Stored XSS
  c) DOM XSS
  d) Blind XSS

  Enter the letter only.
challenges.hint: Think: which one 'persists' on the server?

challenges.title: HTTP Security Header
challenges.desc:
Which HTTP header prevents clickjacking by blocking
  the page from loading inside an iframe?

  Enter the exact header name.
challenges.hint: Starts with X- and contains the word 'Frame'.

challenges.title: File Permissions
challenges.desc:
What does 'chmod 777 file.txt' do?

  a) Makes the file read-only
  b) Full permissions to owner, group and others
  c) Deletes the file
  d) Encrypts the file

  Enter the letter only.
challenges.hint: 7 in octal = 4(read) + 2(write) + 1(execute)

challenges.title: Find the Flag
challenges.desc:
What Linux command finds all files named 'flag.txt'
  starting from the root directory?

  Enter the exact command.
challenges.hint: Use the 'find' command with the -name option.

challenges.title: SUID Bit Hunt
challenges.desc:
What command lists all SUID bit files
  (common privilege escalation target)?

  Enter the exact command.
challenges.hint: Use 'find' with -perm and /4000. Start from /.

challenges.title: Nmap SYN Scan
challenges.desc:
Which Nmap flag performs a SYN stealth scan?

  Enter only the flag (e.g. -X)
challenges.hint: Most popular scan type. '-s' + first letter of 'Syn'.

challenges.title: Wireshark Filter
challenges.desc:
In Wireshark, what display filter shows only HTTP traffic?

  Enter the exact filter string.
challenges.hint: Just the protocol name in lowercase.

challenges.title: Burp Suite Tool
challenges.desc:
Which Burp Suite tool automatically crawls and scans
  a web app for vulnerabilities?

  Enter the tool name (one word).
challenges.hint: It's the automated component — not Repeater or Intruder.

challenges.title: Binary to Text
challenges.desc:
Convert this binary to readable text:

    01000111 01101111 01101111 01100100
challenges.hint: Each 8 bits = 1 ASCII character. Use Python: int('01000111',2)

challenges.title: URL Decode
challenges.desc:
Decode this URL-encoded string:

    %48%61%63%6B%65%72
challenges.hint: Python: from urllib.parse import unquote; unquote('%48%61%63%6B%65%72')

challenges.title: Base32 Decode
challenges.desc:
Decode this Base32 string:

    JBSWY3DPEB3W64TMMQ======
challenges.hint: Python: import base64; base64.b32decode('JBSWY3DPEB3W64TMMQ======').decode()

challenges.title: Hex to ASCII
challenges.desc:
Convert this hex to ASCII:

    726f6f74
challenges.hint: Python: bytes.fromhex('726f6f74').decode()

challenges.title: Double Encoded
challenges.desc:
This string is Base64 encoded TWICE. Decode it:

    Wm05dlpBPT0=
challenges.hint: Decode Base64 once, then decode the result again.

challenges.title: MD5 Length
challenges.desc:
How many characters long is an MD5 hash?

  Enter only the number.
challenges.hint: MD5 produces 128 bits. 128 / 4 = hex digits.

challenges.title: Vigenere Key
challenges.desc:
In a Vigenere cipher, what is the KEY used for?

  a) Shifting letters by a fixed number
  b) Shifting letters by different amounts using a keyword
  c) Replacing letters with numbers
  d) Reversing the alphabet

  Enter the letter only.
challenges.hint: Vigenere uses a repeating keyword, unlike Caesar which uses one shift.

challenges.title: Hash This
challenges.desc:
What is the SHA256 hash of the word:

    password

  Enter only the first 8 characters of the hash.
challenges.hint: Python: import hashlib; hashlib.sha256(b'password').hexdigest()[:8]

challenges.title: Symmetric or Not
challenges.desc:
Which of these is an ASYMMETRIC encryption algorithm?

  a) AES
  b) DES
  c) RSA
  d) Blowfish

  Enter the letter only.
challenges.hint: Asymmetric = uses a public and private key pair.

challenges.title: Atbash Cipher
challenges.desc:
Decrypt this Atbash encoded text:

    SVOOLS

  (Atbash: A=Z, B=Y, C=X ...)
challenges.hint: Map each letter: S→H, V→E, O→L, O→L, L→O, S→H

challenges.title: DNS Record Type
challenges.desc:
Which DNS record type maps a domain name to an IPv4 address?

  Enter the record type (e.g. MX, CNAME, etc.)
challenges.hint: It's a single letter. The most basic DNS record.

challenges.title: Default SSH Port
challenges.desc:
What is the default port for SSH?

  Enter only the number.
challenges.hint: It's lower than 30. Think: secure shell.

challenges.title: TCP Handshake
challenges.desc:
What are the 3 steps of the TCP three-way handshake?

  Enter them separated by dashes (e.g. X-Y-Z)
challenges.hint: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK — just the first word of each step.

challenges.title: Subnet Hosts
challenges.desc:
Network: 10.0.0.0/28

  How many USABLE host IPs does it have?
  (Enter only the number)
challenges.hint: 2^(32-28) = 16 total. Subtract 2.

challenges.title: HTTP Method
challenges.desc:
Which HTTP method is used to SEND data to a server
  (e.g. submitting a login form)?

  Enter the method name.
challenges.hint: Not GET. Think: you are POSTing data.

challenges.title: Cookie Flag
challenges.desc:
Which cookie flag prevents JavaScript from accessing
  the cookie (protects against XSS theft)?

  Enter the exact flag name.
challenges.hint: It means the cookie is only for HTTP, not scripts.

challenges.title: Status Code
challenges.desc:
What HTTP status code means 'Forbidden'?
  (You are authenticated but not allowed)

  Enter only the number.
challenges.hint: 4xx range. Not 401 (that's Unauthorized).

challenges.title: LFI Path

  Enter exactly as typed.
challenges.hint: Go up directories using ../ repeated. Usually 5-6 times.

challenges.title: Current User
challenges.desc:
Which Linux command shows the currently logged-in username?

  Enter the exact command.
challenges.hint: 3 letters. Who am I?

challenges.title: List Hidden Files
challenges.desc:
Which flag with 'ls' shows hidden files (files starting with dot)?

  Enter only the flag (e.g. -x)
challenges.hint: Hidden files start with '.'. Use ls with this flag to show ALL files.

challenges.title: Crontab Backdoor
challenges.desc:
Which file/command do attackers modify to
  persist a backdoor on Linux via scheduled tasks?

  Enter the command name only.
challenges.hint: It schedules recurring tasks. Think: cron + tab.

challenges.title: Read Shadow File
challenges.desc:
What command reads the /etc/shadow file content

  Enter the exact command.
challenges.hint: Simplest way to print file content in Linux. cat + path.

challenges.title: Nmap OS Detection
challenges.desc:
Which Nmap flag enables OS detection?

  Enter only the flag (e.g. -X)
challenges.hint: Capital letter. O for OS.

challenges.title: Metasploit Console
challenges.desc:
What command launches the Metasploit Framework console?

  Enter the exact command.
challenges.hint: MSF + console. Short command.

challenges.title: Gobuster Mode
challenges.desc:
Which Gobuster mode is used for directory brute-forcing?

  Enter the mode name only.
challenges.hint: You are busting directories. Mode = dir.

challenges.title: SQLMap Target Flag
challenges.desc:
Which SQLMap flag specifies the target URL?

  Enter only the flag (e.g. -x)
challenges.hint: URL → U. Short flag.

challenges.desc:
Complete this Hydra command to brute-force SSH

  hydra -l admin ___ -t 4 ssh://192.168.1.1

  Enter only the missing part.
challenges.hint: Flag for password list/wordlist. -P then the path.

Which Google dork operator limits search results

challenges.title: Wayback Machine
challenges.desc:
Which website allows you to view archived/old versions

challenges.hint: It's run by the Internet Archive. Think: going back in time.

challenges.title: Username OSINT Tool
challenges.desc:
Which tool searches a username across 300+ social

  Enter the tool name.
challenges.hint: Sounds like a bird's call. Starts with 'S'.

challenges.hint: Operator: filetype: followed by the extension.

challenges.desc:
Which email header field reveals the ORIGINATING

challenges.hint: It shows the path the email traveled. Starts with 'Received'.

challenges.title: WHOIS Data
challenges.desc:
Which WHOIS field shows when a domain was first registered?

  Enter the exact field name as it appears in WHOIS output.
challenges.hint: Not expiry date. When was it created?
